title: Comparative Molecular Docking of Roscovitine, Nutlin-3, and Pifithrin-α at the CDK2 ATP-Binding Pocket: Interaction Profiling and Implications for p53 Pathway Modulation
one_liner_zh: 该研究仅涉及小分子配体与CDK2蛋白的分子对接，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或转录因子结合体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cyclin-dependent kinase 2 (CDK2) is a key regulator of cell-cycle progression and has been implicated in cancer-related dysregulation of the p53 signaling axis. In this study, molecular docking simulations using AutoDock Vina v1.2.7 were performed to compare the binding behavior of three pharmacologically relevant compounds — Roscovitine, Nutlin-3, and Pifithrin-α — within the ATP-binding pocket of CDK2 (PDB: 1AQ1; resolution: 2.0 Å). Docking reliability was assessed by comparing results across two exhaustiveness settings (Exh = 8 and Exh = 16), with all affinity differences remaining below 0.1 kcal/mol, indicating stable convergence of the search algorithm. Among the three ligands, Pifithrin-α showed the strongest predicted binding affinity (−8.599 kcal/mol), followed by Roscovitine (−8.388 kcal/mol) and Nutlin-3 (−7.501 kcal/mol). Protein-ligand interaction profiling with PLIP revealed distinct interaction patterns for each compound. Roscovitine formed three hydrogen bonds, ten hydrophobic contacts, and one salt bridge with catalytic residues LYS33 and ASP145, consistent with its known ATP-competitive CDK2 inhibition. Pifithrin-α displayed a parallel π-stacking interaction with PHE80 and a short hydrogen bond with LEU83, suggesting a possible CDK2-binding mode that merits further experimental evaluation. Nutlin-3 showed the weakest predicted affinity and the fewest contacts, in line with its established role as an MDM2 antagonist rather than a direct CDK2 ligand. Overall, these findings provide a comparative interaction-level analysis of three p53-pathway-related compounds at CDK2 and support further structure-guided investigation of Pifithrin-α as a potential off-target binder.
abstract_zh: 细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶2 (cyclin-dependent kinase 2, CDK2) 是细胞周期进程的关键调控因子，并已涉及p53信号轴在癌症相关失调中的作用。在本研究中，使用AutoDock Vina v1.2.7进行分子对接模拟，以比较三种药理学相关化合物——Roscovitine、Nutlin-3和Pifithrin-α——在CDK2（PDB：1AQ1；分辨率：2.0 Å）ATP结合口袋内的结合行为。通过比较两种穷尽性设置（Exh = 8和Exh = 16）下的结果来评估对接可靠性，所有亲和力差异均低于0.1 kcal/mol，表明搜索算法具有稳定的收敛性。在三种配体中，Pifithrin-α显示出最强的预测结合亲和力（−8.599 kcal/mol），其次是Roscovitine（−8.388 kcal/mol）和Nutlin-3（−7.501 kcal/mol）。使用PLIP进行的蛋白质-配体相互作用分析揭示了每种化合物不同的相互作用模式。Roscovitine与催化残基LYS33和ASP145形成三个氢键、十个疏水接触和一个盐桥，与其已知的ATP竞争性CDK2抑制作用一致。Pifithrin-α显示出与PHE80的平行π-堆积相互作用以及与LEU83的短氢键，提示其可能存在一种CDK2结合模式，值得进一步实验评估。Nutlin-3显示出最弱的预测亲和力和最少的接触，与其作为MDM2拮抗剂而非直接CDK2配体的既定角色相符。总体而言，这些发现提供了三种p53通路相关化合物在CDK2上的比较性相互作用水平分析，并支持对Pifithrin-α作为潜在脱靶结合剂进行进一步结构导向研究。
